queue.text: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
queue.explanation:
Did you know that you have power within you that God will use to do exceedingly abundantly above what you pray for or pray about? This power is God's love that had been shed abroad our hearts by God's Holy Spirit. 
Would you allow this love to perfect your heart? It is the love of God. It is Christ in us. 
In that LOVE we live , move and have our being. May everything work for your favor.
